notes.title: Mysterious Mystery joins Steam Visual Novel Festival and is 20% off!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We hope you're enjoying the game. We're pleased to announce we're part of the Steam Visual Novel Festival and we're 20% off! Check all the wonderful visual novel games on sale for the even from now until March 10th at 10AM. 

Be sure to leave a review as that really helps us with visibility!

Until next time, happy sleuthing!

notes.title: Mysterious Mystery joins RPG Maker Festival 2025!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We hope you're enjoying the game. We're pleased to announce we're part of the 2025 RPG Maker Festival on Steam! Check all the wonderful RPG Maker games on sale for the even from now until Feburary 10th at 10AM. 

Be sure to leave a review as that really helps us with visibility!

Until next time, happy sleuthing!

notes.title: Mysterious Mystery, EP 1: The Duo Dilemma is now live!
notes.notes:
It's been a long journey but thank you for hanging in there with us. We can't wait for everyone to try the game and share what they think. If you can please leave a review as that really helps us with visibility!

Have Fun!

notes.title: Mysterious Mystery: EP1 Demo Live Broadcast
notes.notes:
Join us for a quick look at Mysterious Mystery as we play the demo and chat about the game during Steam Next Fest!

Be sure to try out the demo and let us know what you think!

Good luck sleuthing!
